summary: Folder mapping: each account can now target a specific remote folder instead of always mirroring the account root.
changelog: Adds an optional Remote Folder field to the setup wizard so an account can mirror a specific Nextcloud folder instead of the entire account root.
Passes the new --path argument to nextcloudcmd when a remote folder is configured; the account root is still used when the field is left as /.
Config schema bumps to version 4; existing single-account and multi-account configurations migrate transparently with the remote path defaulting to the account root.
Account identities now include the remote path, so two accounts against the same server, user, and local folder but different remote folders are treated as distinct.
Setup wizard, summary screen, and account metadata surface the chosen remote folder so users can review the mapping before the safety baseline runs.
